{{Top|leg}}
'''Croutons''' were a type of [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] that was added to [[Salad/Legends|salads]]. [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], a [[Restaurant/Legends|restaurant]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], used to types crouton in its salads: [[Malastarian crouton]]s and [[Hocekureem Sea salt crouton]]s.<ref name="Menu">{{Hyperspace|url=fans/hyperspace/source/dexdiner/index.html|text=Dining at Dex's|int=Dining at Dex's}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Croutons were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Menu" />
